Mixed filename + URL: only the URL becomes an autolink (#397)

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<a href=\"foobar.png\">foobar.png</a> <a href=\"https://www.heise.de\">https://www.heise.de</a>");
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
